chem-bio-01-c2.text: David Fahrney. The Fundamentals of Biochemistry: Interactive Tutorials, The Peptide Bond is Planar. Colorado State University, Biochemistry and Molecular Biology.
chem-bio-01-c2.quote: The partial double bond character of the peptide bond prevents free rotation around the bond.
chem-bio-01-c2.claim: Resonance gives the resulting –CO–NH– bond partial double-bond character, so it's planar and can't rotate freely.

chem-bio-01-c3.text: Ines Moreno-Gonzalez, Claudio Soto (2011). Misfolded protein aggregates: mechanisms, structures and potential for disease transmission. Seminars in Cell & Developmental Biology 22(5):482-487.
chem-bio-01-c3.quote: Some of the most prevalent human degenerative diseases appear as a result of the misfolding and aggregation of proteins.
chem-bio-01-c3.claim: Misfolding is linked to Alzheimer's, Parkinson's, and prion diseases.
